Build the indicator index DataTable

Source: R/fct_plots.R
render_index_table.Rd

Builds a non-paginated DT::datatable listing every distinct indicator name present in mfi, with its World Bank topic and definition.

Usage

render_index_table(mfi, indicator_info)

Arguments

mfi

Data frame of World Bank indicator values, with an Indicator Name column.

indicator_info

Data frame with Indicator Name, Topic and Definition columns (see indicator_info).

Value

A DT::datatable htmlwidget.

Examples

render_index_table(mfi, indicator_info)
